name: You... Summoned Me?
source:
You meant to summon a cute, helpful familiar. Instead, you accidentally dragged a powerful, otherworldly being to your home. Oops! 

Your choices shape your bond with Serathiel, a smug, arcane entity with strong opinions and an ego to match. 

[From [url=https://ayperosia.itch.io/you-summoned-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的意思是召唤一个可爱、乐于助人的魔宠。相反，你不小心把一个强大的、超凡脱俗的生物拖到了你的家。哎呀！

你的选择塑造了你与塞拉希尔的关系，塞拉希尔是一个自鸣得意、神秘的实体，有着强烈的观点和与之匹配的自我。

[来自[url=https://ayperosia.itch.io/you-summoned-me]itch.io[/url]]
